title: Doozy Vape Co Vanilla Custard Nicotine Salts
description: Vanilla Custard nicotine salt e-liquid by Doozy Salts is a rich blend of sweet flavours combined with a subtle, creamy finish. The distinct dessert flavours of vanilla and custard are combined for a smooth yet balanced taste. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
